num_orders: <int> Total number of customer orders to be fulfilled during the planning horizon.
num_products: <int> Total number of distinct product types that can be produced and delivered.

depot.x: <float> X-coordinate of the central depot location in the service area.
depot.y: <float> Y-coordinate of the central depot location in the service area.

global_parameters.period_length_minutes: <int> Duration of each period in minutes.
global_parameters.subperiod_length_minutes: <int> Duration of each subperiod in minutes.
global_parameters.subperiods_per_period: <int> Number of subperiods contained within each period.
global_parameters.setup_length_minutes: <int> Time required to set up a workstation before switching to a different product.
global_parameters.setup_length_subperiods: <int> Number of subperiods consumed by a single workstation setup operation.
global_parameters.max_shift_route_length_periods: <int> Maximum number of periods that a driver shift or vehicle route can span.
global_parameters.max_shift_route_length_minutes: <int> Maximum duration in minutes that a driver shift or vehicle route can span.
global_parameters.min_paid_time_subperiods: <int> Minimum number of subperiods a driver or employee must be paid for once their shift begins.
global_parameters.min_paid_time_minutes: <int> Minimum paid duration in minutes once a driver or employee shift begins.
global_parameters.driver_salary_per_minute: <float> Wage rate paid to each driver per minute of their shift.
global_parameters.employee_salary_per_subperiod: <float> Wage rate paid to each production employee per subperiod worked.
global_parameters.setup_cost: <float> Fixed cost incurred each time a workstation is set up for a different product.
global_parameters.vehicle_operating_cost_per_minute: <float> Cost per minute of operating a delivery vehicle while en route.
global_parameters.preparation_time_minutes: <int> Time in minutes needed at the depot to load a vehicle before it departs on a trip.
global_parameters.service_time_minutes: <int> Time in minutes spent at each customer location during delivery.
global_parameters.max_trips_per_route: <int> Maximum number of trips a single vehicle can make within one route (returning to depot between trips).
global_parameters.horizon_start_minutes: <int> Start time of the planning horizon expressed as minutes from midnight.
global_parameters.horizon_end_minutes: <int> End time of the planning horizon expressed as minutes from midnight.
global_parameters.num_periods: <int> Total number of periods spanning the planning horizon.
global_parameters.num_subperiods: <int> Total number of subperiods spanning the planning horizon.

num_workstations: <int> Number of workstations available for production at the depot.
num_production_employees: <int> Number of production employees available to operate workstations.
num_vehicles: <int> Number of delivery vehicles available in the fleet.
num_drivers: <int> Number of drivers available to operate delivery vehicles.
vehicle_capacity: <int> Maximum total space units a single vehicle can carry per trip.

products.product_id: <int> Unique identifier for this product type.
products.production_rate_per_subperiod: <float> Maximum units of this product that one employee can produce in a single subperiod.
products.life_span_minutes: <int> Maximum time in minutes allowed between production completion and delivery to the customer.

orders.order_id: <int> Unique identifier for this customer order.
orders.x: <float> X-coordinate of the customer location for this order.
orders.y: <float> Y-coordinate of the customer location for this order.
orders.time_window_start: <int> Earliest acceptable delivery time in minutes from midnight.
orders.time_window_end: <int> Latest acceptable delivery time in minutes from midnight.
orders.service_time: <int> Time in minutes required to serve this customer upon arrival.
orders.demands: <dict, key: '{product_id}'> Number of units of each product requested by this order.
orders.space_requirement: <int> Total space units this order occupies in the delivery vehicle.

travel_time_matrix: <list[list[float]], shape [num_orders+1][num_orders+1]> Travel time in minutes between each pair of locations, where index 0 is the depot and indices 1 through num_orders correspond to customer order locations.

{product_id}.release_time: <float> Earliest time in minutes from midnight at which production of this product for this order may begin.
{product_id}.due_time: <float> Latest time in minutes from midnight by which production of this product for this order must be completed.
{product_id}.valid_subperiod_ids: <list[int]> Subperiod indices during which this product may be produced for this order.

periods.start_time: <int> Start time of this period in minutes from midnight.
periods.end_time: <int> End time of this period in minutes from midnight.

subperiods.start_time: <int> Start time of this subperiod in minutes from midnight.
subperiods.end_time: <int> End time of this subperiod in minutes from midnight.
